hero.name: Alex Morgan
hero.subtitle: I build web apps, mobile apps, and the systems behind them — no bootcamp, no degree, just years of building things and figuring out why they broke.

about.text: I'm a self-taught software engineer. Nobody handed me this — no courses, no formal training, no computer science degree. Everything here was learned by building real things, breaking them, and staying up too late figuring out why. It took longer than the traditional path, but it got me somewhere most people only dream about. Today I build web apps, mobile apps, and pretty much everything in between.
